subject: prd/installer
statement: If init targets a directory holding any content beyond the repository metadata directory itself — tracked, untracked, or with no repository at all, then the system shall refuse before any write, enumerate the conflicts, and route to the adoption path (`pyxis adopt`/`apply`; a runnable remedy for a non-git target) per `prd:init-hardening` FR-1/FR-2
intent: a named refusal + the conflict list + the route
fit_criterion: zero writes across the admission fixtures (git and non-git content shapes); every refusal names `adopt`; no refusal claims adoption is unavailable
